d:
Bihar ki rajniti men rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke suprimo lalu prasad yadav ki beti aur rajad netri rohini aachary ne ek bara bayan dekar siyasi halchal tej kar di hai. midiya se batchit karte hue rohini aachary ne bihar ke hit men lalu prasad yadav, nitish kumar aur tejasvi yadav ke phir se ek sath aane ki vakalat ki hai.
'BJP-JDU men tanatni hai, samrat chaudhri bataur siem phel hain'
